questions2.question2: When and how often do you watch films?

questions2_answer.question2: I usually watch films in the evenings after work. I try to watch at least two movies a week, mostly on weekends when I have more free time.

questions3.question3_1: I like to sit near the screen when I go to the cinema? I never drink or eat anything during the film. What about you?
questions3.question3_2: I don’t like watching old back-and-white. They are boring. I prefer modern films, which do you prefer, and why?
questions3.question3_3: Some people say we don’t need cinemas anymore. We can watch everything on TV or online at home? What do you think about this?

questions3_answer.question3_1_answer: I prefer sitting closer to the screen for a better experience, and I enjoy some snacks during the film. It helps me relax and enjoy the movie more. How about you?
questions3_answer.question3_2_answer: I also prefer modern films because of the high-quality visuals and advanced technology. They are more engaging and entertaining, while black-and-white films feel less dynamic and harder to connect with.
questions3_answer.question3_3_answer: While watching films online is convenient, I think cinemas offer a unique experience with a large screen and immersive sound. Watching in a theater still feels special and brings people together.

questions4_main: As you know our weekly film shows are very popular. However, we have had a number of complaints about people using their mobile phones during the film. We have started asking people to turn off their phones before the film starts but this hasn’t solved the problem. We are thinking of banning mobile phones from our cinema in the future and would be interested to hear your view on this. Do you have any other suggestions?
question4_1_text: Write a short email to your friend (about 50 words). Tell your friend what suggestions you will make and why?
question4_2_text: Write an email to the president of the club (about 120-150 words). Write about your ideas and what you think about the situation.
question4_1_text_answer:
Hi Linh,
I heard about the issue with people using their phones during the films. I think banning mobile phones could be a good solution. Alternatively, we could create a designated area for phone users, away from the main seating area. What do you think?
Best,
Phuong
question4_2_text_answer:
Dear Club President,
I am writing to address the ongoing frustration regarding mobile phone usage during film screenings. I fully appreciate concerns that this issue significantly detracts from the immersive viewing experience for many members, impacting the club's atmosphere.
While a complete ban could be considered, I propose initially trialling a designated "phone-friendly" zone. This would allow members who prefer occasional phone use to sit there, ensuring primary viewing areas remain free from digital distractions and promoting a more respectful environment.
Alternatively, we could explore providing attractive and secure phone holders. Positioned conveniently, these could gently encourage members to store their devices prior to the film's commencement, proactively addressing the issue without stringent rules.
These suggestions aim to resolve the problem effectively by enhancing the enjoyment for all members, whilst avoiding potentially unpopular drastic measures.
I hope these ideas are helpful. I eagerly await your thoughts on these proposals.
Yours sincerely,
Phuong
